title: Turkish Herbal Mint Pastry
description: A sweet and refreshing pastry filled with herbal mint and turkish delight.

ingredients.name: Herbal Tea
ingredients.notes: Infused in hot water to make a syrup

instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a small spoonful of Turkish delight in the center of each circle.
Top with a few leaves of fresh mint and a drizzle of herbal tea syrup.
Drizzle with honey and fold the pastry in half to form a triangle.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
